guide.title: Quick Start
guide.step1Desc: Write your resume content using Markdown syntax
guide.step2Desc: View your resume effect in real-time on the right
guide.step3Desc: Export to PDF with one click
guide.dialogDesc: Write Markdown on the left, see your resume on the right — up and running in minutes
guide.editP1: Write Markdown on the left with a live preview on the right. Use the top bar to switch between Source and Rich-text modes; in rich-text mode, just click the text in the preview to edit it.
guide.structH1: H1 · the resume title (name - role); use exactly one per resume
guide.structH2: H2 · sections such as Skills / Work Experience / Projects
guide.structH3: H3 · entries within a section, e.g. project or company names
guide.specialContainer: Left/right columns: write a ::: left block followed by a ::: right block, each closed with ::: — keep them paired and adjacent (that's how the contact line under your name is laid out)
guide.specialIcon: Adds an icon before link text; a bare icon:ri/xx shows the icon alone. Browse all icon names in Page Settings → Icon List
guide.photoUpload: Upload: open Page Settings on the right → Profile Photo, pick an image and click Confirm.
guide.photoAdjust: Adjust: click the photo in the preview to show a control box — drag to move, drag a corner handle to resize.
guide.photoDelete: Delete: select the photo and press Backspace.
guide.saveP1: Auto-save is on by default, so every change is saved automatically. You can turn it off in Page Settings and save manually from the top bar.
guide.exportP1: Export: use the Export menu — "Print to PDF" is recommended (choose "Save as PDF" and set margins to None in the print dialog), or export an image-based PDF / PNG.

items.question: How to export PDF resume?
items.answer: Click the 'Export PDF' button in the top right corner of the editor page to generate a high-definition PDF file with pagination and custom styling support.

items.question: What languages does the resume support?
items.answer: Currently supports Chinese and English. You can switch via the language toggle button in the bottom right corner of the page, with content and UI updating synchronously.

items.question: Does it support offline use?
items.answer: Yes. The project is configured with PWA and can be added to desktop for offline editing. Resources will be automatically cached after the first load.

items.question: Will resume content be lost?
items.answer: No, all content is automatically saved to local cache. Your content will be preserved even after closing the page or refreshing.
